_comment: EQUIPA MCP server hardening (task 2452): privileged tool calls (equipa_dispatch, equipa_task_create) require EQUIPA_MCP_TOKEN. EQUIPA_MCP_COST_CAP_USD bounds 24h dispatch spend. EQUIPA_MCP_PROJECT_IDS optionally restricts task_create targets to a comma-separated allowlist.
_comment_paths: Agents run in the project directory and MCP servers inherit it (tasks 3120/3127). Dispatch is refused unless every stdio server is on the launch allowlist (task 3134, IR-03): an absolute python with -I running an absolute script (or -I -m with an absolute cwd), an absolute node running an absolute script with no -r/--require/--import/--loader/-e/-p, an absolute uvx running a package, or a server executable whose absolute path is listed under "mcp_trusted_executables" in dispatch_config.json (task 3138, RR-02; any other program is refused). The command must exist. Wrappers (timeout, nice, env, setarch, prlimit, systemd-run, sg, su, sudo, ld.so ...), shells (also a renamed copy of one), uv/poetry/pipx/npx/deno/go/make and other runtimes are refused even when listed, as are uvx --with-editable and uvx --from/--with naming a relative path or a project directory, NODE_OPTIONS, PYTHONPATH, PYTHONSTARTUP and LD_* in a server env, and any path argument (also --opt=path) inside a project directory. --db-path must be ABSOLUTE. Replace every /path/to placeholder.
